title: 机场出发步骤指南
prompt: 第一次坐国际航班，从到机场到登机要做什么？按顺序带我看一下。
program:
root = Col([head, guide, sampleNote])
$step = 0
head = Col([Title("第一次坐国际航班", "xl"), Text("从抵达机场到登机，按顺序走完 6 个环节。以下为常见流程示例，请以机场航显和航司通知为准。", "md", "muted")], 2)
guide = Card([progress, drawing, Title(steps[$step].title, "md"), Text(steps[$step].text, "sm"), tagsRow, controls, $step == 5 ? checklist : null], null, 4, 3)
progress = Row([Badge("第 " + ($step + 1) + " / 6 步", "info"), Spacer(), Caption(@Round(@Percent($step + 1, 6)) + "%")], 2)
drawing = Box([drawings[$step]], null, null, 3, "surface", "lg")
tagsRow = Row(@Each(steps[$step].tags, "t", Badge(t, "purple")), 1, null, null, true)
controls = Row([Button("上一步", @Set($step, @Clamp($step - 1, 0, 5)), "outline", null, null, "arrow-left", $step == 0), Spacer(), Button($step == 5 ? "再看一遍" : "下一步", $step == 5 ? @Set($step, 0) : @Set($step, @Clamp($step + 1, 0, 5)), "solid", null, null, "arrow-right")], 2)
steps = [{title: "1 · 到机场", text: "国际航班通常提前 3 小时到机场。先根据航站楼信息找到国际/港澳台出发入口。", tags: ["提前 3 小时", "T3 示例"]}, {title: "2 · 值机与托运", text: "找到航司值机柜台，用护照取登机牌；大件行李在这里托运，确认行李直挂目的地。", tags: ["护照", "登机牌", "托运行李"]}, {title: "3 · 出境检查", text: "持护照和登机牌通过边检；如有海关申报物品走申报通道，否则走无申报通道。", tags: ["边检", "海关"]}, {title: "4 · 安全检查", text: "把手机、电脑、充电宝、液体和外套放进托盘；水和打火机不能随身携带。", tags: ["锂电池", "液体 100ml", "外套"]}, {title: "5 · 候机", text: "看登机牌上的登机口和开始登机时间，听广播和航显；一般起飞前 20–30 分钟开始登机。", tags: ["B12 示例", "听广播"]}, {title: "6 · 登机", text: "排队出示登机牌和护照，工作人员扫码或撕牌后，沿廊桥登机。", tags: ["登机牌+护照", "对号入座"]}]
checklist = List([ListItem("护照、签证和登机牌随身带", "不要放进托运行李"), ListItem("液体单瓶不超过 100ml", "放在 1L 透明袋"), ListItem("充电宝和锂电池只能随身", "不能托运"), ListItem("登机口可能变更", "以航显和广播为准")], "number")
drawings = [d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5]
d0 = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 130, "surface"), Rect(20, 52, 200, 68, "surface", "ink", 2), Path("M20 52 L120 24 L220 52", "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(102, 78, 36, 42, "info", "ink", 2), Circle(200, 36, 16, "#FFFFFF", "ink", 2), Line(200, 36, 205, 28, "ink", 2), Line(200, 36, 208, 41, "ink", 2), Circle(58, 86, 5, "ink"), Line(58, 91, 58, 106, "ink", 2), Line(58, 94, 50, 100, "ink", 2), Line(58, 94, 66, 100, "ink", 2), Line(58, 106, 52, 116, "ink", 2), Line(58, 106, 64, 116, "ink", 2), Rect(76, 106, 16, 14, "chart1", "ink", 1.5), SvgText("T3", 64, 32, 11, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("提前 3 小时", 120, 34, 11, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 130")
d1 = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 130, "surface"), Rect(30, 52, 140, 8, "chart2", "ink", 1.5), Rect(30, 60, 140, 34, "surface", "ink", 1.5), Circle(194, 42, 7, "ink"), Rect(187, 49, 16, 22, "purple", "ink", 1.5), Circle(46, 76, 6, "ink"), Rect(39, 82, 14, 24, "chart1", "ink", 1.5), Rect(128, 68, 28, 26, "info", "ink", 1.5), Line(142, 68, 142, 58, "ink", 1.5), Rect(134, 50, 20, 8, "muted", "ink", 1.5), Polygon("58,46 84,46 90,52 90,62 58,62", "success", "ink", 1), SvgText("登机牌", 74, 57, 9, "white", "middle"), SvgText("行李托运", 142, 112, 10, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("值机柜台", 50, 24, 11, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 130")
d2 = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 130, "surface"), Rect(20, 40, 150, 50, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(20, 40, 150, 8, "chart3", "ink", 1.5), Circle(184, 46, 7, "ink"), Rect(177, 53, 14, 22, "chart6", "ink", 1.5), Circle(54, 80, 6, "ink"), Rect(47, 86, 14, 24, "chart1", "ink", 1.5), Rect(82, 74, 16, 20, "info", "ink", 1.5), SvgText("护照", 90, 86, 8, "white", "middle"), Rect(62, 64, 18, 8, "warning", "ink", 1), SvgText("边检/海关", 120, 24, 11, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("出示护照+登机牌", 120, 116, 10, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 130")
d3 = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 130, "surface"), Rect(60, 36, 80, 82, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(170, 40, 48, 50, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(150, 78, 20, 12, "surface", "ink", 1.5), Rect(154, 68, 6, 6, "warning", "ink", 1), Circle(168, 28, 4, "info"), Circle(38, 66, 6, "ink"), Rect(31, 72, 14, 26, "chart1", "ink", 1.5), Line(31, 72, 24, 90, "ink", 1.5), Line(45, 72, 52, 90, "ink", 1.5), SvgText("安检门", 100, 24, 10, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("托盘", 160, 112, 10, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("电子产品/液体取出", 120, 126, 9, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 130")
d4 = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 130, "surface"), Rect(80, 16, 80, 28, "info", "ink", 1.5), SvgText("B12", 120, 35, 12, "white", "middle"), Rect(30, 90, 50, 22, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(30, 90, 50, 8, "chart2", "ink", 1), Rect(130, 90, 50, 22, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(130, 90, 50, 8, "chart2", "ink", 1), Circle(196, 82, 6, "ink"), Rect(189, 88, 14, 22, "chart1", "ink", 1.5), Line(189, 110, 203, 110, "ink", 2), Rect(50, 48, 70, 34, "ink"), SvgText("航班 MU123", 85, 60, 9, "surface", "middle"), SvgText("10:40 登机", 85, 74, 9, "success", "middle"), SvgText("看登机口和广播", 120, 126, 9, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 130")
d5 = Svg([Rect(0, 0, 240, 130, "surface"), Rect(70, 60, 110, 26, "surface", "ink", 2), Rect(130, 26, 70, 18, "surface", "ink", 2), Polygon("200,26 220,20 220,50 200,44", "surface", "ink", 2), Polygon("130,30 120,20 120,28", "surface", "ink", 2), Circle(45, 72, 5, "ink"), Rect(38, 77, 14, 22, "chart1", "ink", 1.5), Circle(70, 72, 5, "ink"), Rect(63, 77, 14, 22, "chart2", "ink", 1.5), Circle(95, 72, 5, "ink"), Rect(88, 77, 14, 22, "chart3", "ink", 1.5), SvgText("登机口", 100, 24, 10, "muted", "middle"), SvgText("出示登机牌+护照", 120, 114, 9, "muted", "middle")], "0 0 240 130")
sampleNote = Caption("示例数据：T3、B12、MU123 仅为演示，请按实际行程确认。", "muted")
